messages.subject: Error when trying to use tileMethylCounts function
parts:
Hi,

I wonder if anyone has faced this issue before?

I am trying to run DMR analysis on 100bp tiles.

my code:
require(methylKit)

filelist=list("alignment1.sam","alignment2.sam");
bismarkobj=read.bismark(location=filelist,sample.id=list("BRH024","BRH026"),assembly="rn5",save.folder=NULL, save.context="CpG",nolap=FALSE,mincov=5,minqual=30,phred64=FALSE,treatment=c(0,1))
filtered.bismarkobj = filterByCoverage(bismarkobj, lo.count=5, lo.perc=NULL, hi.count=NULL, hi.perc=99.9)
meth = unite(filtered.bismarkobj,destrand=TRUE)
methcor=getCorrelation(meth,plot=T)
cmatrix = percMethylation(meth)
myDiff = calculateDiffMeth(meth,num.cores=4)
tiles = tileMethylCounts(filtered.bismarkobj,cov.bases=5,win.size=100,step.size=50)
myDMR = unite(tiles,destrand=TRUE)
DMR = calculateDiffMeth(myDMR,num.cores=3)


Error:
Error in .Call2("solve_user_SEW0", start, end, width, PACKAGE = "IRanges") :
  solving row 1: range cannot be determined from the supplied arguments (too many NAs)
Calls: tileMethylCounts ... newGRanges -> IRanges -> solveUserSEW0 -> .Call2 -> .Call
Execution halted

It works for all previous analysis which are "mm9" and "hg19". But, when I am doing it on "rn5", it fails.
I am thinking that it is because I am using "rn5" and it is somehow not found in the "session"?
If this is true, how do I go about getting "rn5" into the "session"/"path"?

Thank you.


Wilson
